definitions.gloss: telework; remote work; working from home
definitions.explanation: Working outside of a traditional office, typically from home, using telecommunications technology.

examples.japanese: {今日|きょう}はテレワークです。
テレワークが{普及|ふきゅう}した。
テレワークと{出社|しゅっしゃ}を{組|く}み{合|あ}わせている。
examples.english: I combine remote work and going to the office.

notes:
テレワーク (from 'telework') refers to remote work using telecommunications technology.

ETYMOLOGY:
テレ (tele-, remote) + ワーク (work)

SYNONYMS:
- リモートワーク: remote work
- {在宅|ざいたく}{勤務|きんむ}: working from home
- {在宅|ざいたく}ワーク: work-from-home

RELATED TERMS:
- ハイブリッドワーク: hybrid work (combining remote and office)
- オンライン{会議|かいぎ}: online meeting
- {出社|しゅっしゃ}: going to the office
- {時差|じさ}{出勤|しゅっきん}: staggered commuting

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- テレワークをする: to work remotely
- テレワーク{可能|かのう}: remote work possible
- テレワーク{導入|どうにゅう}: introducing telework

USAGE:
Became widespread in Japan during the COVID-19 pandemic. Now a standard work option at many companies.
